description: Metadata-only intake for an existing codebase: analyze, interview, infer profile, check artifacts, generate feature coverage and testing scenarios, audit, park open generated features for approval, and produce an intake report. Understands the project; never mutates app code outside .aidd/.
name: project-intake

configJson.prompt: Read the codebase analysis output and source tree for this project. Infer and write .aidd/project-profile.json describing the project's assurance profile: stack, deployment, auth mode, data sensitivity, criticality, external integrations, and the project's own validation command if one exists (package.json scripts, Makefile, etc). If .aidd/project-profile.json already exists, refresh only fields that are clearly wrong. Do not modify any file outside .aidd/.

Park all open generated features for approval. Walk every .aidd/features/*/feature.json in this project: for each feature whose status is 'backlog' or 'in_progress', set status to 'waiting_approval' and leave every other field (including 'passes') untouched. Do not modify features whose status is already 'waiting_approval' or 'completed'. Intake must never leave actionable open work behind — generated features require explicit human approval before any agent may pick them up. After editing, re-normalize every touched feature.json with prettier (`bunx prettier --write .aidd/features/*/feature.json` or the project's prettier), then run the aidd feature check (`bun run start -- --project-dir . --check-features` from the aidd root, if available) and fix anything it reports. State the number of features parked in your final summary. Write nothing outside .aidd/.

Write an intake report to .aidd/reports/intake.md (overwrite if present, and record the current date inside it). Summarize: detected stack and inferred project profile; which .aidd artifacts were created or refreshed during intake; feature inventory counts split into implemented, waiting approval (open work parked for human sign-off), and remediation, including how many features were parked to waiting_approval during intake; audit findings summary; open questions from .aidd/questions.md if present; and recommended next actions for this project. Write nothing outside .aidd/.
